data.text:
Omprakash Gupta vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 12
December, 2024 
Author: Vivek Kumar Birla
Bench: Vivek Kumar Birla
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
? Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:194649-Db
Court No. - 29 
Case :- Writ - C No. - 41352 of 2024
Petitioner :- Omprakash Gupta 
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Avanish Kumar Pandey
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
1.  Heard Shri Avanish Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the petitioner as well as Shir Ambrish Shukla, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel appearing for the State respondents. 
2. Present petition has been filed with following prayer:-
Omprakash Gupta vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171360309/
1 "a. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari to quash the effect and operation of the impugned order dated 01.08.2024 passed by the Additional District Magistrate (Administration)/Judicial Officer, Bulandshahar (respondent no.2) as well as R.C.Paper No.36 dated 02.12.2024 issued by the respondent no.4 (enclosed as Annexure No.1 to the writ petition).
b. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the respondents not to take any coercive action against the petitioner and also prevent to take penalty of Rs.40,000/- from the petitioner. "
3. A preliminary objection has been raised that the petitioner has effective alternative remedy by filing an appeal under section 71 of the Food Safety & Standard Act, 2006 and therefore, the present petition is not maintainable. It is further submitted that the recovery citation is only a consequential order. 
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner could not dispute the same. He, however, submits that some delay may have occurred in filing the appeal. 
5. Accordingly, the present petition stands dismissed on the ground of effective alternative statutory remedy available to the petitioner. However, it is provided that in case the appeal is filed within a period of 10 days from today, the same shall be entertained by the authority concerned without any objection regarding delay in filing the appeal. 
Order Date :- 12.12.2024 Nitendra  Omprakash Gupta vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171360309/
2
